Interpret the vibrant neon green kinetic ribbons as dynamic, sweeping strokes of rich emerald and cadmium green impasto oil paint with visible palette-knife textures and heavy physical relief. Condition the global painterly style, impasto depth, tactile brush textures, and lighting strictly on the four stylized keyframe references (Image1 through Image4). As the dancer moves, the green structural ribbons and red surface filaments self-paint across the scene, blending rich green and crimson paint against the pure dark void with dramatic raking studio light illuminating every 3D wet paint ridge, ultra-detailed fine art.
